學歷

香港樹仁大學法律與工商管理文憑

 

簡介

張偉光博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院院長兼教授。他擁有香港科技大學的金融博士學位，曾在嶺南大學，格里菲斯大學，科廷大學和弗林德斯大學任教。在加入城市大學之前，他曾擔任科廷大學金融與銀行系系主任以及弗林德斯大學商業、政治與法學院商業研究组别主管（相當於副院長（學術方向））。 張偉光博士的研究興趣是與金融相關的實證問題。他長期的研究興趣是了解當代商業問題中的金融/財務機制。目前，他試圖從金融/財務角度了解諸如企業社會責任，無形資本，LGBT，社交媒體，比特幣和貿易信貸等問題。他曾獲得各種研究資助，包括中國國家自然科學基金會，澳中未來對話基金會和AFAANZ研究資助。他還是北京大學和香港科技大學的訪問學者。他的出版物曾在國際上期刊上發表，其中包括：公司金融期刊, 銀行與金融期刊，商業道德期刊，英國會計評論, 澳大利亞管理，會計與金融期刊，當代會計與經濟學期刊，商業研究期刊，經濟模型，能源經濟學，應用經濟學和亞洲經濟學雜誌等。

2025年9月19日，斯坦福大學發佈了「全球前2%頂尖科學家榜單（World’s Top 2% Scientists）」的最新排名。在「2024年度科學影響力排行榜」中， 張偉光博士上榜入選經濟與商業領域（Economics & Business）的「年度科學影響力排行榜」。他之前也被列入了 2021, 2022, 和 2023年的名單中。

研究方向

學術工作經驗

  • 2019- ：澳門城市大學金融學教授兼院長
  • 2018-2019：弗林德斯大學商業學教授兼研究部負責人
  • 2015-2018：科廷大學金融與銀行學副教授
  • 2011-2014：科廷大學金融與銀行高級講師
  • 2004-2011：格里菲斯大學金融與經濟學講師

張偉光博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院院長兼教授。他擁有香港科技大學的金融博士學位，曾在嶺南大學，格里菲斯大學，科廷大學和弗林德斯大學任教。在加入城市大學之前，他曾擔任科廷大學金融與銀行系系主任以及弗林德斯大學商業、政治與法學院商業研究组别主管（相當於副院長（學術方向））。 張偉光博士的研究興趣是與金融相關的實證問題。他長期的研究興趣是了解當代商業問題中的金融/財務機制。目前，他試圖從金融/財務角度了解諸如企業社會責任，無形資本，LGBT，社交媒體，比特幣和貿易信貸等問題。他曾獲得各種研究資助，包括中國國家自然科學基金會，澳中未來對話基金會和AFAANZ研究資助。他還是北京大學和香港科技大學的訪問學者。他的出版物曾在國際上期刊上發表，其中包括：公司金融期刊, 銀行與金融期刊，商業道德期刊，英國會計評論, 澳大利亞管理，會計與金融期刊，當代會計與經濟學期刊，商業研究期刊，經濟模型，能源經濟學，應用經濟學和亞洲經濟學雜誌等。
2025年9月19日，斯坦福大學發佈了「全球前2%頂尖科學家榜單（World’s Top 2% Scientists）」的最新排名。在「2024年度科學影響力排行榜」中， 張偉光博士上榜入選經濟與商業領域（Economics & Business）的「年度科學影響力排行榜」。他之前也被列入了 2021, 2022, 和 2023年的名單中。

Bibliography

Dr. Wai Kong (Adrian) Cheung is currently the Dean and Professor of Finance, Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He received his PhD in finance from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.  He previously taught at Lingnan University, Griffith University, Curtin University, and Flinders University. Before joining City University, he served as Head of Department of Finance and Banking at Curtin University and Research Section Head (equivalent to Associate Dean (Research)) in the College of Business, Governance and Law at Flinders University, respectively. Adrian's research interest is empirical issues in finance. His long-standing research interest is in understanding the finance mechanisms underlying contemporary business issues. Currently he seeks to understand issues like CSR, intangible capital, LGBT, social media, bitcoin, and trade credit from a finance perspective. He has been the recipient of various research grants, including National Natural Science Foundation of China, Australia-China Future Dialogues Fund, and AFAANZ Research Grant. He was also a visiting scholar at Peking University and Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. His publications have appeared in international journals: Journal of Corporate Finance, Journal of Banking and Finance, Journal of Business Ethics, British Accounting Review, Financial Review, International Review of Economics and Finance, International Journal of Finance and Economics, Australian Journal of Management, Accounting and Finance, Journal of Contemporary Accounting and Economics, Journal of Business Research, Economic Modelling, Energy Economics, Applied Economics, and the Journal of Asian Economics. 

On September 19th, 2025, Stanford University released the latest ranking of "World's Top 2% Scientists". In the "2024 Science Impact Rankings", Dr. Cheung was included in Economics & Business's "Science Impact Rankings of the Year". He was previously included in the 2021, 2022, and 2023 lists.

Dr. Wai Kong (Adrian) Cheung is currently the Dean and Professor of Finance, Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He received his PhD in finance from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.  He previously taught at Lingnan University, Griffith University, Curtin University, and Flinders University. Before joining City University, he served as Head of Department of Finance and Banking at Curtin University and Research Section Head (equivalent to Associate Dean (Research)) in the College of Business, Governance and Law at Flinders University, respectively. Adrian's research interest is empirical issues in finance. His long-standing research interest is in understanding the finance mechanisms underlying contemporary business issues. Currently he seeks to understand issues like CSR, intangible capital, LGBT, social media, bitcoin, and trade credit from a finance perspective. He has been the recipient of various research grants, including National Natural Science Foundation of China, Australia-China Future Dialogues Fund, and AFAANZ Research Grant. He was also a visiting scholar at Peking University and Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. His publications have appeared in international journals: Journal of Corporate Finance, Journal of Banking and Finance, Journal of Business Ethics, British Accounting Review, Financial Review, International Review of Economics and Finance, International Journal of Finance and Economics, Australian Journal of Management, Accounting and Finance, Journal of Contemporary Accounting and Economics, Journal of Business Research, Economic Modelling, Energy Economics, Applied Economics, and the Journal of Asian Economics.
On September 19th, 2025, Stanford University released the latest ranking of "World's Top 2% Scientists". In the "2024 Science Impact Rankings", Dr. Cheung was included in Economics & Business's "Science Impact Rankings of the Year". He was previously included in the 2021, 2022, and 2023 lists.

zh.article_html:
鄺婉樺, 副教授

金融學院副教授

副院長

 

聯絡資料

辦公室: 2201c

辦公室電話: 8590-2629

電郵: evakhong@cityu.edu.mo

 

學歷

葡萄牙里斯本大學博士

英國巴斯大學碩士

英國赫特福德大學管理學文憑

香港嶺南大學學士

 

 

簡介

鄺婉樺博士在金融學院擔任副教授和副院長，博士生論文導師。 她畢業於香港嶺南大學，分別獲得巴斯大學（英國）和Instituto Superior de Ciencias do Trabalho e da Empresa（葡萄牙）的碩士學位和博士學位。 她曾在嶺南大學（香港）和澳門大學任教，亦曾赴中國、法國、葡萄牙、新加坡講學。 她歷年擔任人力資源管理和戰略管理的諮詢、培訓及項目研究的工作。 研究領域包括創新創業管理，全球比較管理，金融人力資源管理和亞太地區企業戰略管理。

 

教學科目

·             金融專題講座

.         金融前沿專題研究

.         研究報告 (I) (II)

研究方向

·            金融人力資源管理

·         企業戰略管理

·         創新創業管理

工作經驗

·          2013 至今               澳門城市大學  副教授  副院長  

·         2006/09-迄今　　   澳門城市大學副教授

·         1989/09-2006/08　澳門大學助理教授

·         1982/08-1989/09　香港嶺南大學助理教授

 

專業學會資格

·         2019-至今    Member of Editorial Board of Amity Journal of Management

·         2016-至今    澳洲管理會計師 教育(專上教育) 委員會副會長

·         2007-至今    澳門大學工商管理學院顧問委員會榮譽委員

·         2006-迄今　Global Economics and Management Review編輯

·         2005-迄今　國際管理學會東南亞區董事會成員

簡介
鄺婉樺博士在金融學院擔任副教授和副院長，博士生論文導師。 她畢業於香港嶺南大學，分別獲得巴斯大學（英國）和Instituto Superior de Ciencias do Trabalho e da Empresa（葡萄牙）的碩士學位和博士學位。 她曾在嶺南大學（香港）和澳門大學任教，亦曾赴中國、法國、葡萄牙、新加坡講學。 她歷年擔任人力資源管理和戰略管理的諮詢、培訓及項目研究的工作。 研究領域包括創新創業管理，全球比較管理，金融人力資源管理和亞太地區企業戰略管理。

Dr. Eva Khong is presently working as Associate Professor ,Associate Dean in Faculty of Finance, as well as Graduate Programme Thesis Supervisor.  She was graduated from Hong Kong Lingnan University, and earned her Master Degree and PhD Degree from Bath University (U.K.) and Instituto Superior de Ciencias do Trabalho e da Empresa (Portugal) respectively. 簡介

Arman Eshraghi教授擁有二十年的學術研究、教學和領導經驗，曾在英國（卡迪夫大學、愛丁堡大學和曼徹斯特大學）任職，並在美國（哈佛大學）、英國（劍橋大學、倫敦大學學院）以及亞洲（日本、中國、新西蘭）擔任訪問學者。在進入學術界之前，他還在銀行業擁有數年的專業經驗。Eshraghi教授在行為金融學、金融科技以及公司金融/治理等領域享有國際聲譽，其研究成果發表于金融、會計和管理學領域的頂尖同行評審期刊，包括《 Review of Financial Studies》、《 Review of Finance》、《 Accounting, Organizations and Society》以及《哈佛商業評論》。他的研究獲得了廣泛的媒體報道（包括《金融時報》、《福布斯》、《華盛頓郵報》、彭博社、BBC、歐洲新聞台）。他現任《Global Finance Journal》（ABDC 'A'級，影響因子：5.5）的主編，以及《British Accounting Review》和《European Journal of Finance》的副主編。作為一位活躍的國際學者，Eshraghi教授已在全球範圍內受邀舉辦了55場學術研討會，發表了45場主題演講，並共同主持了20場國際學術會議，其中包括歐洲一些最大規模的金融學會議。他曾擔任卡迪夫金融科技研究組的創始聯合主任、行為金融學協會（主辦歐洲規模最大的行為金融學專題會議）的聯合主任，並通過威爾士金融科技機構和英國政府為英國的金融政策討論做出了貢獻。埃什拉吉教授也是一位屢獲殊榮的教育者，在MBA、理學碩士和博士層面均有卓越教學表現。他曾在11個國家教授過多樣化的金融學課程，並在高管教育和公共參與方面擁有豐富經驗，例如，他做過一次關於金融科技的TEDx演講，在YouTube上的觀看次數約25萬次，並為金融播客及其他媒體活動撰稿。

Fellow, Higher Education Academy (Advance HE)

 

Biography

Arman Eshraghi is a professor of finance with two decades of academic research, teaching and leadership experience across the UK (Cardiff University, University of Edinburgh, University of Manchester) , visiting fellowships in the US, UK, Japan and New Zealand, and some years of professional experience in the banking sector prior to academia. Prof. Eshraghi's research and scholarship is internationally recognized in areas including behavioral finance, financial technology, and corporate finance/governance with publications in leading peer-reviewed journals across finance, accounting and management, including the Review of Financial Studies , Review of Finance , Financial Management, Journal of Empirical Finance, Journal of Business Finance and Accounting, Accounting, Organizations and Society, British Journal of Management,  and the Harvard Business Review . His research has received wide media coverage including the Financial Times , Forbes , Washington Post, Bloomberg , BBC and  Euronews . He is currently the Editor-in-Chief of the Global Finance Journal  (Q1, ABDC A) and Associate Editor of the British Accounting Review (Q1, ABDC A*) and the European Journal of Finance  (Q1, ABDC A) .

As an active international scholar, Prof. Eshraghi has delivered around 60 invited seminars worldwide, 55 invited keynotes and co-chaired 20 international academic conferences including some of the largest finance conferences in Europe. He has served as the founding director of Cardiff Fintech Research Group , co-director of Behavioral Finance Association  which hosts the world's largest conference series on behavioral finance,  and has contributed to UK financial policy discussions through Fintech Scotland ,  Fintech Wales and the UK Government. Prof. Eshraghi is also an award-winning educator across MBA, MSc, and PhD levels. He has taught a diverse range of finance modules across 11 countries and has extensive experience in executive education and public engagement, eg, a TEDx talk on financial technology with around 250,000 views on YouTube, contributions to finance podcasts and other media engagements.

周泳宏，經濟學博士

簡介

周泳宏現任澳門城市大學金融學院經濟學教授。他的研究領域包括政治經濟學、經濟增長與發展、港澳經濟等，近期特別關注國際關係、衝突、文化、政治對經濟的影響。他的論文發表在Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization， European Journal of Political Economy, Empirical Economics, China Economic Review, 經濟學（季刊）,中國工業經濟，統計研究等期刊上。更多信息請訪問他的個人網站（https://sites.google.com/view/zhouyh/home）。

Biography

Yonghong Zhou is currently a Professor in Economics at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. His fields of specialization include Political Economy, Economic Growth and Development, and Economies of Hong Kong and Macao. His recent interests include the impact of international relations, conflict, culture, and politics on the economy. His publications have appeared in SSCI journals and the top ranked Chinese journals such as Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, European Journal of Political Economy, Empirical Economics, China Economic Review, 經濟學（季刊）,中國工業經濟，統計研究. For more information, please visit his personal website (https://sites.google.com/view/zhouyh/home).

楊挺

副教授及碩士研究生課程主任

 

聯絡資料

辦公室: 2203b

辦公室電話: 8590-2242

電郵: tingyang@cityu.edu.mo

 

WOS Researcher ID: KGL-6740-2024

Scopus ID: 8717124800

ORCID: 0000-0002-5204-2347

 

學歷

南洋理工大學博士（金融學）

西南財經大學經濟學學士

 

簡介

楊挺博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院副教授。他在新加坡南洋理工大學獲得博士學位（金融學）。在加入澳門城市大學之前，他曾在新西蘭奧克蘭理工大學金融系工作了約 18年。在從事學術職業之前，他在工業界工作了大約 4 年。

楊博士教授過本科及研究生金融課程。在2009年，他獲得了奧克蘭理工大學商學院頒發的“以學生為中心的學習優秀獎”。

楊博士目前的研究興趣為公司金融、市場微觀結構和投資學。他的研究成果曾在國際會議上宣講，曾發表在Journal of Banking and Finance, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, Accounting and Finance, International Review of Financial Analysis等金融期刊上。

楊博士曾擔任約20個學術期刊的審稿人，約6個博士論文的校外評審，以及多個金融會議的審稿人、討論者或宣講者。

 

教學科目

公司金融；投資學；國際金融

 

研究方向

公司金融；金融市場微觀結構; 投資學; 與中國市場相關研究

 

學術工作經驗

2023-至今: 澳門城市大學金融學院副教授

2004-2023: 新西蘭奧克蘭理工大學金融系高級講師

Academic Qualifications

Ph.D. (in Finance), Nanyang Technological University, Singapore

Bachelor of Economics, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, China

 

Biography

Dr. Ting Yang is currently an associate professor of finance at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He received a Ph.D. degree (in finance) from the Nanyang Technological University. Before joining the City University of Macau, he worked at the Department of Finance of the Auckland University of Technology in New Zealand for more than 18 years. Prior to pursuing an academic career, he worked in industry for about 4 years.  

Dr. Yang has taught finance courses for bachelors, and research and professional masters programs. He won the Excellence in Student Centered Learning Award from Faculty of Business, Auckland University of Technology in 2009.

Dr. Yang’s current research interests are in the areas of corporate finance, market microstructure, and investments. His research work has been presented at international conferences and published in refereed finance journals including Journal of Banking and Finance, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, Accounting and Finance, and International Review of Financial Analysis.

Dr. Yang has been serving the academic community by acting as an ad-hoc referee for about 20 academic journals, an external examiner for around 6 Ph.D. theses, and a reviewer, discussant, or presenter for many finance conferences.

Corporate Finance; Investments; International Finance

學歷

維也納經濟與商業大學, 經濟與社會科學博士

維也納經濟與商業大學, 經濟學碩士

 

簡介

我現任澳門城市大學金融學院應用經濟學教授。在加入澳門城市大學之前，我曾在奧地利、中國、德國、英國/馬來西亞和新加坡的多所大學擔任各級經濟學與國際商務教授。2020年至2023年，我入選上海高校「東方學者」計畫，並列入上海市國外高層次人才專案。除了學術任職之外，我還曾在奧地利國家銀行和奧地利經濟研究院工作數年，將學術知識與實踐應用相結合並從事政策諮詢。

 

我的大學教學經驗已達25年，面向本科（理學學士）、研究生（理學碩士、工商管理碩士）和博士生教授多個經濟學與國際商務相關課程，並指導了大量博士論文、研究生和本科生畢業論文。

我目前的研究聚焦於國際投資協定及投資者—國家爭端解決機制，以及它們對跨國企業決策和政府經濟政策的影響。我曾獲得多個高競爭力科研專案資助（如奧地利科學基金、上海市人才發展基金），並在多家國際權威期刊上發表多篇學術文章。

我還是奧地利經濟研究院的研究員，該研究院由諾貝爾經濟學獎得主F.A.馮·哈耶克和L.馮·米塞斯創立；是英國高等教育學會的准研究員；並擔任 JCR 一區期刊《新興市場金融與貿易》和《人文與社會科學通訊》的版塊編輯。

  • 計量經濟學
  • 商業統計學

  • 政策評估
  • 漁業經濟學

VIENNA UNIVERSITY OF ECONOMICS AND BUSINESS, Habilitation in Economics

 

Short Introduction

I am a Professor of Applied Economics at the School of Finance at the City University of Macau. Before joining City University of Macau, I was a Professor (all ranks) of Economics and International Business at universities in Austria, China, Germany, Great Britain / Malaysia, and Singapore. From 2020 to 2023, I was an Oriental Scholar (“東方學者”計劃) of Shanghai Universities, and I was included in the foreign high-talent program of Shanghai. In addition to my academic appointments, I spent several years outside academia (at the Austrian National Bank and the Austrian Institute of Economic Research) to supplement my academic knowledge with practical application and to engage in policy consulting. My teaching experience at universities spans 25 years. I taught courses on various economics- and international business-related subjects for undergraduate (BSc), postgraduate (MSc, MBA), and PhD students. I have supervised numerous PhD theses, as well as postgraduate and undergraduate dissertations. My current research focuses on international investment agreements and investor-state dispute settlement, examining their impact on the decisions of multinational enterprises and on governments' economic policies. I received funding from highly competitive sources (e.g., the Austrian Science Fund and the Shanghai Talent Program), and I have published numerous articles in reputable international journals. I am a Research Associate at the Austrian Institute of Economic Research, founded by Nobel Memorial Prize laureate F.A. von Hayek and L. von Mises. I am an Associate Fellow of Higher Education (Great Britain), a Subject Editor of Emerging Markets Finance and Trade, and an Editor of Humanities and Social Science Communications, both of which are JCR Q1 journals.

Short Introduction
I am a
Professor of Applied Economics
at the School of Finance at the City University of Macau. Before joining City University of Macau, I was a Professor (all ranks) of Economics and International Business at universities in Austria, China, Germany, Great Britain / Malaysia, and Singapore. From 2020 to 2023, I was an
Oriental Scholar
(“
東方學者
”
計劃
) of Shanghai Universities, and I was included in the
foreign high-talent program of Shanghai
. In addition to my academic appointments, I spent several years outside academia (at the
Austrian National Bank
and the
Austrian Institute of Economic Research
) to supplement my academic knowledge with practical application and to engage in policy consulting. My teaching experience at universities spans 25 years. I taught courses on various economics- and international business-related subjects for undergraduate (BSc), postgraduate (MSc, MBA), and PhD students. I have supervised numerous PhD theses, as well as postgraduate and undergraduate dissertations. My current research focuses on international investment agreements and investor-state dispute settlement, examining their impact on the decisions of multinational enterprises and on governments' economic policies. I received funding from highly competitive sources (e.g., the Austrian Science Fund and the Shanghai Talent Program), and I have published numerous articles in reputable international journals. I am a
Research Associate
at the
Austrian Institute of Economic Research
, founded by Nobel Memorial Prize laureate F.A. von Hayek and L. von Mises. I am an
Associate Fellow of Higher Education
(Great Britain), a
Subject Editor of Emerging Markets Finance and Trade
, and an
Editor
of
Humanities and Social Science Communications
, both of which are JCR Q1 journals.

簡介

李建強博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院教授。他有二十多年豐富的教學及科研經驗, 指導過數十位博士畢業生, 曾任南昌大學特聘教授傑出人才、台灣中山大學管理學院終身教授等。曾擔任美國, 英國, 馬來西亞, 羅馬尼亞及泰國等高校訪問學者。長期從事綠色金融、能源金融、可持續金融等領域。主持國家社會科學基金重點項目、省部級項目等。入選”2024ScholarGPS全球前0.05%頂尖學者(近五年)”、 “全球前2%頂尖科學家”、 “馬奎斯世界名人錄終身成就獎”、“中國高被引學者”、“安子介國際貿易研究獎” 、“高等教育國家級教學成果獎“ 等獎項。在Web of Science上H指數78，累計被引用超過2萬餘次。先後擔任Energy Economics、Energy Journal、Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews、Applied Economics、Economic Analysis and Policy、Innovation and Green Development、Data Science and Management、Emerging Markets Finance and Trade等期刊的主編及客座主編，以綠色金融, 能源轉型, 可持續金融, 人工智能等為主題開設特刊。

綠色金融、能源金融、數字金融、國際金融、可持續金融

Biography

Dr. Chien-Chiang Lee is currently a Professor of Finance at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. With over 20 years of extensive teaching and research experience, Dr. Lee has supervised numerous PhD graduates. He has held prestigious academic positions, including Distinguished Professor and Talent Scholar at Nanchang University, and Lifetime Professor at the School of Management, Sun Yat-sen University in Taiwan. Dr. Lee has been a visiting scholar at universities in the United States, the United Kingdom, Malaysia, Romania, and Thailand. His research focuses on green finance, energy finance, international finance, and sustainable finance. He has led major projects funded by the National Social Science Fund of China as well as provincial-level initiatives. Dr. Lee has received numerous accolades, including recognition among the “Top 0.05% of Highly Ranked Scholars™”, "Top 2% of Scientists Worldwide," "Lifetime Achievement Award" from Marquis Who’s Who, designation as a "Highly Cited Researcher in China," the "T. K. Ann International Trade Award," and the "National Teaching Achievement Award in Higher Education." With an H-index of 78 and over 20,000 citations on Web of Science, Dr. Lee has served as editor, associate editor, and guest editor for journals such as Energy Economics, Energy Journal, Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, Applied Economics, Economic Analysis and Policy, Innovation and Green Development, Data Science and Management, and Emerging Markets Finance and Trade. He has organized special issues on topics including green finance, energy transition, sustainable finance, and artificial intelligence.

 

Research Areas

Green Finance, Energy Finance, Digital Finance, International Finance, and Sustainable Finance.

李強, 經濟學博士

教授

簡介

     李強，現任澳門城市大學金融學院經濟學教授。他的研究長期聚焦於人力資本、家庭結構等勞動經濟學領域，在Health Economics (HE), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), Economic Modelling (EM), China Economic Review (CER),《經濟學（季刊）》，《中國農村經濟》等SSCI與CSSCI權威期刊發表了30餘篇論文，論文被引用超1000次，參與及主持多項國家社會科學基金重點項目、國家自然科學基金面上項目等課題，出版專書和調查報告共5部，獲四川省社會科學優秀成果三等獎。承接博士研究生《數據分析與建模》及本科生《統計學原理》、《定量研究方法高階》等課程。北京大學、中山大學訪問學者，北佛羅裡達大學國家公派訪問學者，擔任中國勞動經濟學會理事，廣州鄉村振興研究會理事；經濟學（季刊），世界經濟、中國農村經濟、公共管理評論，HE, EM, JHS, CER, SSM, EHB等權威期刊匿名審稿人。

 

教學科目

博士課程：數據分析與建模

碩士課程：高級計量經濟學、發展經濟學、社會科學方法論、公共經濟學

本科課程：機器學習與數據分析、計量經濟學、統計學原理（中、英文）、定量研究方法高階、金融計量經濟學、健康經濟與政策、經濟英語（英文）

 

研究領域

勞動經濟、健康經濟、環境經濟

李強，現任澳門城市大學金融學院經濟學教授。他的研究長期聚焦於人力資本、家庭結構等勞動經濟學領域，在Health Economics (HE), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), Economic Modelling (EM), China Economic Review (CER),《經濟學（季刊）》，《中國農村經濟》等SSCI與CSSCI權威期刊發表了30餘篇論文，論文被引用超1000次，參與及主持多項國家社會科學基金重點項目、國家自然科學基金面上項目等課題，出版專書和調查報告共5部，獲四川省社會科學優秀成果三等獎。承接博士研究生《數據分析與建模》及本科生《統計學原理》、《定量研究方法高階》等課程。北京大學、中山大學訪問學者，北佛羅裡達大學國家公派訪問學者，擔任中國勞動經濟學會理事，廣州鄉村振興研究會理事；經濟學（季刊），世界經濟、中國農村經濟、公共管理評論，HE, EM, JHS, CER, SSM, EHB等權威期刊匿名審稿人。

Bibliography

Qiang Li is currently a Professor of Economics at the School of Finance, City University of Macau. His research focuses on development economics, particularly in the fields of environment, health, and family structure. He has published over 30 papers in SSCI and CSSCI journals such as Health Economics (HE), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), Economic Modelling (EM), China Economic Review (CER), China Economics Quarterly, and China Rural Economy. His work has been cited more than 800 times. He has led and participated in multiple national-level research projects, including key projects under the National Social Science Fund and the National Natural Science Foundation of China. He has authored five monographs and research reports and received the Third Prize in the 17th Sichuan Provincial Outstanding Achievement in Social Sciences. He teaches courses such as "Data Analysis and Modeling" for doctoral students and "Principles of Statistics", "Advanced Quantitative Research Methods" for undergraduate students. He is a visiting scholar at Peking University and Sun Yat-sen University, and a government-sponsored visiting scholar at the University of North Florida. He serves as a council member of the China Labor Economics Society and Council Member of Guangzhou Research Association for Rural Revitalization. He serves as an anonymous reviewer for authoritative journals including China Economics Quarterly, The World Economy, China Rural Economy, Public Administration Review, Health Economics (HE), Economic Modelling (EM), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), China Economic Review (CER), Social Science & Medicine (SSM), and Economy and Human Biology (EHB).

Qiang Li is currently a Professor of Economics at the School of Finance, City University of Macau. His research focuses on development economics, particularly in the fields of environment, health, and family structure. He has published over 30 papers in SSCI and CSSCI journals such as

He has led and participated in multiple national-level research projects, including key projects under the National Social Science Fund and the National Natural Science Foundation of China. He has authored five monographs and research reports and received the Third Prize in the 17th Sichuan Provincial Outstanding Achievement in Social Sciences. He teaches courses such as "Data Analysis and Modeling" for doctoral students and "Principles of Statistics", "Advanced Quantitative Research Methods" for undergraduate students. He is a visiting scholar at Peking University and Sun Yat-sen University, and a government-sponsored visiting scholar at the University of North Florida. He serves as a council member of the China Labor Economics Society and Council Member of Guangzhou Research Association for Rural Revitalization. He serves as an anonymous reviewer for authoritative journals including China Economics Quarterly, The World Economy, China Rural Economy, Public Administration Review, Health Economics (HE), Economic Modelling (EM), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), China Economic Review (CER), Social Science & Medicine (SSM), and Economy and Human Biology (EHB).

簡介

李偉平博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院副教授。他擁有香港城市大學的金融博士學位，並曾在中山大學任教。在加入城市大學之前，他曾擔任中山大學國際金融學院助理教授。李偉平博士的主要研究興趣是公司金融、綠色金融、數位金融和文化金融。目前已在Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Financial Stability、Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money、Business Strategy and the Environment、Energy Economics、Humanities and Social Sciences Communications(nature旗下刊物)、Pacific-Basin Finance Journal、International Review of Economics and Finance. Finance、會計研究等國際SSCI/SCI與國內CSSCI期刊發表多篇論文。主持廣東省自然科學基金面上項目1項。他也擔任Humanities and Social Sciences Communications(Nature旗下刊物, SSCI Q1)與Scientific Reports(Nature旗下刊物, SCI Q1)期刊編委, China Journal of Accounting Research(ABS2, ESCI Q1)的青年編委，西南財經大學中國政府審計研究中心（CCGAR）的研究員。此外，他也是中國會計學術聯盟青年學者委員會的委員，以及泰山學院商學院的兼任教授。請造訪他的Google學術頁面以了解更多資訊（https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=-IFsMDgAAAAJ&hl）

 

指導與合作

我非常致力於指導學生並促進合作研究環境的形成。我熱情地邀請對學術研究充滿熱情並希望在未來追求教職的本科生、研究生和博士生。如果你渴望參與學術工作並尋求你學術旅程的指導，請隨時與我聯繫。我已經指導並與我的學生合作，在一些著名的SSCI期刊上發表了文章，例如Journal of Business Ethics(FT50, ABS3, SSCI Q1), Journal of Financial Stability(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Business Strategy and the Environment(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Energy Economics(SSCI1, 會計研究科學基金Markets Review(SSCI Q1), China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1)等期刊發表論文。
也歡迎有興趣的博士和學者來申請訪問，共同進行研究。

  • 金融前沿話題
  • 管理學原理

簡介
李偉平博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院副教授。他擁有香港城市大學的金融博士學位，並曾在中山大學任教。在加入城市大學之前，他曾擔任中山大學國際金融學院助理教授。李偉平博士的主要研究興趣是公司金融、綠色金融、數位金融和文化金融。目前已在Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Financial Stability、Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money、Business Strategy and the Environment、Energy Economics、Humanities and Social Sciences Communications(nature旗下刊物)、Pacific-Basin Finance Journal、International Review of Economics and Finance. Finance、會計研究等國際SSCI/SCI與國內CSSCI期刊發表多篇論文。主持廣東省自然科學基金面上項目1項。他也擔任Humanities and Social Sciences Communications(Nature旗下刊物, SSCI Q1)與Scientific Reports(Nature旗下刊物, SCI Q1)期刊編委, China Journal of Accounting Research(ABS2, ESCI Q1)的青年編委，西南財經大學中國政府審計研究中心（CCGAR）的研究員。此外，他也是中國會計學術聯盟青年學者委員會的委員，以及泰山學院商學院的兼任教授。請造訪他的Google學術頁面以了解更多資訊（https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=-IFsMDgAAAAJ&hl）
指導與合作
我非常致力於指導學生並促進合作研究環境的形成。我熱情地邀請對學術研究充滿熱情並希望在未來追求教職的本科生、研究生和博士生。如果你渴望參與學術工作並尋求你學術旅程的指導，請隨時與我聯繫。我已經指導並與我的學生合作，在一些著名的SSCI期刊上發表了文章，例如Journal of Business Ethics(FT50, ABS3, SSCI Q1), Journal of Financial Stability(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Business Strategy and the Environment(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Energy Economics(SSCI1, 會計研究科學基金Markets Review(SSCI Q1), China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1)等期刊發表論文。
也歡迎有興趣的博士和學者來申請訪問，共同進行研究。

Biography

Dr. Li Weiping is currently an associate professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He holds a Ph.D. in Finance from City University of Hong Kong. Before joining City University, he served as an assistant professor at the International School of Business & Finance at Sun Yat-sen University. Dr. Li's main research interests include corporate finance, green finance, digital finance, and cultural finance. He has published numerous papers in international SSCI/SCI journals such as the Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Financial Stability, Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money, Business Strategy and the Environment, Energy Economics, Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Series), Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, International Review of Economics and Finance, and Accounting & Finance. He is the principal investigator of a project funded by the Natural Science Foundation of Guangdong Province. In addition to his academic role, he serves as editorial board member of Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Series, SSCI Q1) and young editorial board member of China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1). He is also a member of the Center for China’s Governmental Auditing Research (CCGAR) at the Southwest University of Finance and Economics. Furthermore, he is an esteemed member of the Young Scholars Committee within the Accounting Academic Alliance in China. He is also the special appointed professor at Business School, Taishan University.

Please visit his Google scholar for more information(https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=-IFsMDgAAAAJ&hl)

 

Supervision

I am deeply committed to mentoring students and fostering a collaborative research environment. I extend an enthusiastic invitation to undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD students who are passionate about academic research and aspire to pursue a faculty position in the future. If you are eager to engage in scholarly endeavors and seek guidance on your academic journey, please do not hesitate to reach out. I have supervised and cooperate with my student to publish a series famous SSCI journals, like Journal of Business Ethics(FT50, ABS3, SSCI Q1), Journal of Financial Stability(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Business Strategy and the Environment(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Energy Economics(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Journal of Accounting Literature(ABS3), 会计研究Accounting Research(CSSCI), Emerging Markets Review(SSCI Q1), China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1).

Biography
Dr. Li Weiping is currently an associate professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He holds a Ph.D. in Finance from City University of Hong Kong. Before joining City University, he served as an assistant professor at the International School of Business & Finance at Sun Yat-sen University. Dr. Li's main research interests include corporate finance, green finance, digital finance, and cultural finance. He has published numerous papers in international SSCI/SCI journals such as the Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Financial Stability, Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money, Business Strategy and the Environment, Energy Economics, Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Series), Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, International Review of Economics and Finance, and Accounting & Finance. He is the principal investigator of a project funded by the Natural Science Foundation of Guangdong Province. In addition to his academic role, he serves as editorial board member of Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Series, SSCI Q1) and young editorial board member of China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1). He is also a member of the Center for China’s Governmental Auditing Research (CCGAR) at the Southwest University of Finance and Economics. Furthermore, he is an esteemed member of the Young Scholars Committee within the Accounting Academic Alliance in China. He is also the special appointed professor at Business School, Taishan University.
Please visit his Google scholar for more information(
https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=-IFsMDgAAAAJ&hl
)
Supervision
I am deeply committed to mentoring students and fostering a collaborative research environment. I extend an enthusiastic invitation to undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD students who are passionate about academic research and aspire to pursue a faculty position in the future. If you are eager to engage in scholarly endeavors and seek guidance on your academic journey, please do not hesitate to reach out. I have supervised and cooperate with my student to publish a series famous SSCI journals, like Journal of Business Ethics(FT50, ABS3, SSCI Q1), Journal of Financial Stability(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Business Strategy and the Environment(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Energy Economics(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Journal of Accounting Literature(ABS3), 会计研究Accounting Research(CSSCI), Emerging Markets Review(SSCI Q1), China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1).

簡介

蘇飛博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院副教授。他擁有悉尼科技大學金融學博士學位和澳門大學經濟學碩士學位。在加入澳門城市大學之前，他曾任職南京航空航天大學經濟與管理學院副教授，並擔任金融學專業建設負責人。蘇飛博士的主要研究興趣包括公司金融、金融風險以及金融市場微觀結構。目前已在International Review of Financial Analysis、International Journal of Finance & Economics、Pacific-Basin Finance Journal等國際知名SSCI期刊發表多篇論文。主持國家自然科學基金青年基金項目1項、江蘇高校哲學社會科學研究重大項目1項。他還擔任國際期刊Journal of Transition Economics and Finance副主編和Journal of Chinese Economic and Business Studies青年編委。

  • 資產組合管理

  • 公司金融
  • 金融市場
  • 金融市場微觀結構

Biography

Dr. Fei Su is currently an associate professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He holds a Ph.D. in Finance from UTS Business School and an M.Sc. in Economics from University of Macau. Before joining City University of Macau, he served as a lecturer and an associate professor (tenured) at the College of Economics and Management, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics. Dr. Su's research interests include corporate finance, financial market, and market microstructure. He has published numerous papers in renowned international SSCI/SCI journals such as the International Review of Financial Analysis, International Journal of Finance & Economics, and Pacific-Basin Finance Journal. He has served as the principal investigator (PI) of a project funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC). In addition to his academic role, he serves as an early career editorial board member of Journal of Chinese Economic and Business Studies (ESCI Q1) and an associate editor of Journal of Transition Economics and Finance.

  • Portfolio Management

Research Areas

學術工作經驗

2026-今： 澳門城市大學 副教授

2021-2026： 澳門城市大學 助理教授

 

學歷:

澳門大學 工商管理博士

澳大利亞國立大學 金融管理碩士

遼寧大學 管理學學士

 

簡介

于博博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院副教授。他本科畢業于遼寧大學，並於澳大利亞國立大學取得碩士學位。澳門大學授予他博士學位。他的主要研究興趣是資產定價、交易策略及公司治理。他的論文曾經在International Review of Financial Analysis, Asia-Pacific Journal of Accounting and Economics和Economies上發表，並擔任International Review of Financial Analysis和 Emerging Markets Finance and Trade的審稿人。另外于博士的研究在多個學術會議上進行講演，包括：the 12th International Symposium of Quantitative Economics、2023 International Conference on Firm Governance、2nd and 4th International Conference on Financial Regulation and Financial Stability、32nd Australasian Finance and Banking Conference及2019 Cross Country Perspectives in Finance (CCPF) – Sustainable Finance Conference。

 

教學科目

  • 固收債券
  • 投資組合管理
  • 金融學原理
  • 學術專題項目I
  • 風險管理簡介

 

研究方向

  • 資產定價
  • 交易策略
  • 公司治理

Bibliography

Dr. Bo YU is currently the Associate Professor of Finance, Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He finished his undergraduate education at Liaoning University. He earned his Master Degree from Australian National University. He received his PhD degree from University of Macau. His major research interests are assets pricing, trading strategy and corporate governance. His publications have appeared in international journals, including: International Review of Financial Analysis, Asia-Pacific Journal of Accounting and Economics and Economies and he also works as the reviewer of International Review of Financial Analysis and Emerging Markets Finance and Trade. In addition, his works has also been presented in various academic conferences, namely: the 12th International Symposium of Quantitative Economics, 2023 International Conference on Firm Governance, 2nd and 4th International Conference on Financial Regulation and Financial Stability, the 32nd Australasian Finance and Banking Conference and 2019 Cross Country Perspectives in Finance (CCPF) – Sustainable Finance Conference.

簡介

白羽博士目前在澳門城市大學金融學院擔任助理教授。先前，他曾在博科尼大學擔任研究員，後來在蒙納士大學擔任研究員。他的研究興趣主要集中在經濟計量學，包括理論和應用兩個方面，同時也是他的主要教學領域。他的研究成果發表在包括《統計計算與模擬期刊》、《應用經濟計量期刊》和《計量經濟與統計期刊》在內的國際期刊上。

 

 

 

教學科目：

  • 金融與經濟研究方法
  • 研究報告I
  • 時間序列分析
  • 金融機構管理
  • 計量經濟學

 

研究方向：

  • 計量經濟學理論與應用

 

論文發表

  1. Local GMM estimation for nonparametric time-varying coefficient moment condition models. (accepted) Journal of Time Series Analysis. 2025. https://doi.org/10.1111/jtsa.12822
  2. Mean group instrumental variable estimation of time-varying large heterogeneous panels with endogenous regressors, with G. Kapetanios and M. Marcellino, forthcoming in the Econometrics & Statistics.
  3. Macroeconomic Forecasting in a Multi-country Context, joint with A. Carriero, T. E. Clark and M. Marcellino. Journal of Applied Econometrics, 37(6), 1230-1255, 2022. 
  4. A Monte Carlo comparison of GMM and QMLE estimators for short dynamic panel data models with spatial errors, joint with Shaofu Zhou and Zhaoyuan Fan. Journal of Statistical Computation and Simulation, 88(2), 376-409, 2018.

 

工作論文

  1. ‎Optimal bandwidth selection for forecasting under parameter instability. joint with B. Peng, S. Shi and W. Yao.  Revision requested by Journal of Financial Econometrics.

簡介

陳學政老師目前擔任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授一職。此前，他曾在江西財經大學經濟學院任副教授，在四川大學經濟學院任特聘副研究員。 陳老師2001年从廈門大學獲得經濟學學士學位，後於2013年從英國華威大學獲得經濟學博士學位。 陳老師的主要研究領域包括政治經濟學、金融經濟學以及行為與實驗經濟學，多篇專業論文發表於國內外一流期刊，如《經濟研究》、《Journal of Comparative Economics》和《International Review of Economics and Finance》等。陳老師曾在多項國家級課題研究項目中擔任主要研究員，科研成果荣获多個獎項，包括国内重要学术会议的優秀論文獎和四川省社會科學優秀成果獎等。 除此之外，陳老師還是《經濟研究》、《Journal of Politics》、《Small Business Economics》、《International Political Science Review》、等著名期刊以及Routledge / Taylor & Francis出版社的評審人。

 

主要研究領域

政治經濟學，金融經濟學，行為與實驗經濟學

 

研究成果

  •  已發表的著作
  • 2024（第一作者），The Impact of Differential COVID-19 Pandemic Control and Prevention Policies on International Trade and Capital Flows（差異化新冠疫情管控政策對國際貿易與資本流動影響的理論與實證研究）, Emerging Markets Finance and Trade （SSCI一區；ABDC: B；影響因子4.0）, 已線上發表 。（合著者：Chi GONG, Yuanqiao LONG, Chunlin WAN 和Lei ZHANG）
  • 2024（第一作者），A Theory of Symbiotic Corruption（共生性腐敗理論）， Journal of Comparative Economics (SSCI一區；ABDC: A；影響因子2.7）, 52(2): 478-494. (合著者：Lin GUI, Tao WU 和 Jun ZHANG合著)
  • 2024（通訊作者），The No Surcharge Rule and its Welfare Implication（信用卡無附加費規則對社會福利影響的理論研究）, International Review of Economics and Finance（SSCI一區；ABDC: A；影響因子4.5）89(A): 1369-1384. (合著者：Hongru TAN)
  • 2019，Alleviating Financing Constraints of SMEs Through Supply Chain, Sustainability （SSCI二區，影響因子3.9）, 11, 673. （合著者：Yang YANG, Jing GU, and Hamido Fujita）
  • 2018（通讯作者），A Decision-Making Framework Based on Prospect Theory under An Intuitionistic Fuzzy Environment（模糊环境下基于前景理论的决策模型），Technological and Economic Development of Economy (SSCI一區，影響因子5.9)，24(6), 2374-2396. （合著者：Jing GU, Zijian WANG 和 Zeshui XU）
  • 2018（第一作者）， 《分而治之及其再分配效应》被《中国人民大学复印报刊资料（理论经济学）》2018年第4期全文收录。（合著者：龔馳和張雷）
  • 2017（第一作者），《分而治之及其再分配效应》，《经济研究》第12期，149-163。（合著者：龔馳和張雷）
  • 2016（通讯作者），On the Scale free laws of Urban Facilities (论城市设施的无标度幂律), Physics Letters A（SCI二區，影響因子2.7）, 380(3 ): 349-352.（合著者：Liang WU和Yang LI）
  • 2015（通讯作者），The Evolution and Impact of China’s Regional Policy: A Study of Regional Support Policy for Western China (区域政策的演变与效果：针对中国西部区域政策的案例分析) , The Evolution of Economic and Innovation Systems, Springer International Publishing, 2015: 119-141.（合著者：Zheng LU和Xiang DENG）

陳學政老師目前擔任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授一職。此前，他曾在江西財經大學經濟學院任副教授，在四川大學經濟學院任特聘副研究員。 陳老師2001年从廈門大學獲得經濟學學士學位，後於2013年從英國華威大學獲得經濟學博士學位。 陳老師的主要研究領域包括政治經濟學、金融經濟學以及行為與實驗經濟學，多篇專業論文發表於國內外一流期刊，如《經濟研究》、《Journal of Comparative Economics》和《International Review of Economics and Finance》等。陳老師曾在多項國家級課題研究項目中擔任主要研究員，科研成果荣获多個獎項，包括国内重要学术会议的優秀論文獎和四川省社會科學優秀成果獎等。 除此之外，陳老師還是《經濟研究》、《Journal of Politics》、《Small Business Economics》、《International Political Science Review》、等著名期刊以及Routledge / Taylor & Francis出版社的評審人。

Bibliography

Dr. Chen currently holds the position of Assistant Professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. Previously, he served as an Associate Professor at the School of Economics, Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics, and an Associate Research Fellow at the School of Economics, Sichuan University. Dr. Chen graduated from Xiamen University with a Bachelor Degree in Economics in 2001 and obtained a PhD Degree in Economics from the University of Warwick in 2013. Dr. Chen's primary research areas include Political Economy, Financial Economics, and Behavioral and Experimental Economics. He has published several research papers in distinguished domestic and international journals, such as Economic Research Journal（《经济研究》）, Journal of Comparative Economics, and International Review of Economics and Finance. Dr. Chen has served as the principal investigator in multiple national-level research projects. His research achievements have been recognized with various awards, including Outstanding Paper Awards at two top-tier academic conferences and an provincial-level Outstanding Achievement Award. In addition, Dr. Chen has served as an anonymous peer reviewer for several renowned journals, including Economic Research Journal, Journal of Politics, Small Business Economics, International Political Science Review, and for the Routledge / Taylor & Francis publishing house.

 

Research Areas

Dr. Chen graduated from Xiamen University with a Bachelor Degree in Economics in 2001 and obtained a PhD Degree in Economics from the University of Warwick in 2013. 華君怡博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。她擁有美國俄亥俄州大學的經濟學博士學位。作為一名應用計量經濟學者，她運用微觀數據來理解微觀個體的經濟行為。她熱衷於研究經濟區域內農業、環境問題（如氣候變化、水資源與空氣污染）、土地供給、政策和城市化的相互關係，以及基於這些關係的可持續經濟發展的政策建議。在她所參與的美國 USDA 科研項目 Thriving Agricultural Systems in Urbanized Landscapes 中，她與生態、水文、環境科學等其他專業學者進行跨學科合作研究，通過提出有效可行的政策建議來解決政府管理成本導致的負外部性、資訊不對稱以及適應環境變化所導致的隱藏成本。

 

教學科目

計量經濟學，時間序列分析，學術專題，研究報告

美國經濟熱點問題；環境與自然資源經濟學；宏觀經濟學原理，中級微觀經濟學原理，體育經濟學

 

研究方向

環境與能源經濟學，應用計量經濟學，農業與土地利用經濟學，城市經濟學，氣候變化，實證產業組織、離散選擇模型 (Discrete Choice Modeling) 與消費者選擇模型的建立

 

擅長

空間地理GIS資料和衛星資料的處理分析，水文網路追蹤與水質分析，結構模型建立與計算

Bibliography

Dr. Junyi Hua is currently an Assistant Professor of Economics at Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. She received her PhD in Agricultural, Environmental, and Development Economics from The Ohio State University. As an applied econometrician, her research uses micro-level data to understand human behavior at a micro-level. Her research focus is on the agricultural implications and housing supply changes resulting from the effects of climate change on land markets and agricultural outcomes. Her interest in exploring issues of sustainable economic growth from the perspective of land use management in the short and long run leads to productive collaboration with researchers in ecology, hydrology, and environmental earth sciences seeking viable and effective policy solutions to cope with the negative externalities including the implicit cost of government regulation and the implicit costs of adaption to environmental challenges. Understanding of how farmers and landowners respond to changes in climate factors, as well as the impact of these changes on the urbanizing landscape is a unifying theme in her research program. Her research consists of three core components. The first component is the understand the drivers of agricultural decision making and resulting land prices. The second is to embed agricultural behavior into models of urbanization. Lastly, she combines these ideas to examine climate change scenarios impacts on urbanization patterns and agricultural behavior.

Econometrics; Economic Issues in the United States; Environmental and Natural Resources Economics; Principle of Macroeconomics; Economics of Sports; Intermediate Microeconomic Theory

Dr Di Li is currently an Assistant Professor of Finance, Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He completed his undergraduate study at Harbin University of Commerce and was educated at Bangor University. After three-year working in industry he went to Monash University and obtained his PhD degree. His major research interests include behavioral finance, corporate governance, energy economics, and banking. His research work has been published in the journals, including Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, Frontiers in Energy Research, and Energy Economics. His working papers have been presented at the conferences such as Australasian Finance and Banking Conference, International Conference on Energy Finance, and KFUPM conference on Islamic banking and finance. At present, he is engaging several research projects related to green finance and clean energy finance.

學歷：

馬德里卡洛斯三世大學 經濟分析碩士

對外經濟貿易大學 經濟學學士（國際經濟與貿易專業）

 

簡介：

李蒙博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。他於西班牙馬德里卡洛斯三世大學獲經濟學博士學位，曾在西南財經大學財政稅務學院任教。其研究領域包括宏觀經濟學、財政政策、一般均衡理論、經濟周期、收入和財富不平等以及國際稅收等；科研論文曾發表在《宏觀經濟動態》《經濟模型》等國際期刊，並擔任《宏觀經濟動態》《亞太經濟》《應用經濟學》《新興市場金融與貿易》等學術期刊的匿名審稿人；還與另兩位學者合作出版了專作《數字中國：財稅政策優化與制度構建》。李蒙博士曾獲得教育部人文社會科學研究一般項目青年項目和澳門教育基金的資助。在加入澳門城市大學之前，他主持過西南財經大學校级教学改革项目。他曾榮獲稅務專業碩士教學指導委員會第三屆全國稅務案例大賽二等獎和西南財經大學第四屆“課程思政”教學競賽暨優秀教案評選一等獎，指導學生獲得第三屆全國本科稅收風險管控案例分析大賽二等獎、第三屆四川省大學生財稅實務技能大賽二等獎、第二屆成渝雙城經濟圈高校稅務案例大賽一等獎以及西南財經大學“優秀碩士學位論文光華獎”。所授《國際稅收》課程曾榮獲四川省省級線上一流本科課程稱號。

 

教學科目：

  • 宏觀經濟學導論
  • 發展經濟學

 

研究方向：

  • 宏觀經濟學
  • 財政政策
  • 一般均衡理論
  • 經濟周期
  • 收入和財富不平等
  • 國際稅收

 

學術工作經驗：

  • 2024至今：澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授
  • 2018-2023：西南財經大學財政稅務學院副教授
  • 2017-2018：西南財經大學財政稅務學院助理教授

 

論文發表：

  1. Li, M., and Xiao, C. (2023) Income Sources, Cyclical Behaviors of Fiscal Policy, and Welfare Conflict. Macroeconomic Dynamics (SSCI), 27(8):2137-2164.
    doi:10.1017/S1365100522000621
  2. Li, M. (2023) Loss Aversion and Inefficient General Equilibrium over the Business Cycle. Economic Modelling (SSCI), 118: 106086.
    doi: 10.1016/j.econmod.2022.106086.

 

學術會議：

  • Xiao, C., and Li, M. January 2024, Corporate Income Tax and Heterogeneous Firm Outward Foreign Direct Investment Decisions: Evidence from China, 2024 Asia Meeting of Econometric Society, South/Central/West (Delhi, India).
  • Chowdhury, K., Kumru, C., and Li, M. June 2025, Addressing Low Annuity Demand with Capital Taxes, Universidad Carlos III de Madrid Ph.D. Alumni Conference (Madrid Spain).

 

主持課題：

  • 《中國居民收入不平等波動性的機理分析和路徑優化》，教育部人文社會科學研究一般項目青年項目資助。
  • Addressing Low Annuity Demand with Capital Taxes，澳門教育基金“2024/2025學年高等院校年度資助計劃”——澳門高等院校教研人員專業發展資助（第二期）之SU24-1184610於研討會發表論文。

 

專著：

  • 宋洋、方圓、李蒙（2024），《數字中國：財稅政策優化與制度構建》，北京：經濟科學出版社，ISBN：9787521861815。

Dr. Meng Li is currently an Assistant Professor in Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He received his PhD degree from University of Carlos III in Madrid and worked in Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. His major research interests are macroeconomics, fiscal policy, business cycle, general equilibrium, income and wealth inequality, and international taxation. His research papers have been published in international journals, including Macroeconomic Dynamics and Economic Modelling. He works as an anonymous reviewer of some international journals, such as Macroeconomic Dynamics, Journal of the Asia Pacific Economy, Applied Economics, and Emerging Markets Finance and Trade. ORCID: 0000-0001-7409-8934

 

簡介：

劉偲現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。本人2018年畢業於英國雷丁大學ICMA中心，取得金融學博士學位。曾任西南財經大學金融學院副教授、碩導。主要從事公司金融、公司治理、機構投資者以及銀行監管等方面的研究。個人代表作‘The IRB model, bank regulatory arbitrage, and the Eurozone crisis’曾在美國金融學會年會博士生專場(AFA 2018 Philadelphia)展示，並以獨立作者身份發表在金融領域國際知名高水平期刊Journal of International Money and Finance。同時，本人另有7篇一作/通訊作者論文發表在國際高水準期刊（SSCI 1區)，期中 International Review of Financial Analysis 1篇，Finance Research Letters 5篇，Pacific Basin Finance Journal 1篇）。此外，本人曾作為主研參與省部級項目2項。本人在任教西南財經大學期間,曾擔任主講人之一的線上課程《投資學》，已於2020年上線中國大學慕課平台MOCC。該課程於2022年獲得四川省省級一流（線上）本科課程。

 

教育背景：

2014-2018 英國雷丁大學, ICMA中心, 金融學博士

2013-2014 英國雷丁大學, ICMA中心, 金融風險管理碩士

2011-2013 英國加迪夫大學, 商學院, 會計與金融學士

2009-2011 北京師範大學 (珠海) , 國際商學院, 金融學 (2+2) 項目

 

 

 

 

學術工作經驗：

  • 2024.08至今：澳門城市大學, 金融學院, 助理教授
  • 2019.07-2024.07：西南財經大學, 金融學院, 副教授
  • 2019.01-2019.07：西南財經大學, 金融學院, 講師

 

研究方向

  • 公司金融
  • 機構投資者
  • 銀行監管

 

論文發表

  1. Liu, C., 2021. The IRB model, bank regulatory arbitrage, and the Eurozone crisis. Journal of International Money and Finance, 102411 （獨立作者，ABS 3，國際金融領域著名期刊）（該論文作為個人博士論文代表作，曾在美國金融學會年度會議博士生專場展示 (AFA 2018 Philadelphia PhD Session）
  2. Liu, C., and Varotto, S., 2021. Is Small Beautiful? The Resilience of Small Banks during the European Debt Crisis. International Review of Financial Analysis, 101793
  3. He, X. and Liu, C., 2023. Monitoring Attention of Institutional Investors and Trade Credit Financing. Finance Research Letters, 104007 （通訊作者）
  4. Liu, C., and Yin, C., 2023. Institutional Investors’ Monitoring Attention, CEO Compensation, and Relative Performance Evaluation，Finance Research Letters，104121（一作&通訊）
  5. Li, W. P., Xie, C. Y., & Liu, C. (2024). The power of the many: how retail investor attention reshapes corporate trade credit and bank loans. Finance Research Letters. Volume 69 Part B, 106217 （通訊作者）
  6. Liu, C., & He, X. X. (2025). The unintended consequences of retail investor attention: the case of the long-term use of short-term debt. Finance Research Letters. Volume 82, 107587
  7. Yao, K., Zheng, Z.X., & Liu, C. (2025). The Colour of Finance Words in Chinese. Pacific-Basin Finance Journal. Available online 23 June 2025, 102854
  8. Zhang, N., & Liu, C. (2026). Confucian culture and corporate maturity mismatch: evidence from China. Finance Research Letters, 87, 108961. https://doi.org/10.1016/J.FRL.2025.108961 （通訊作者）
  9. Liu, C., (2025). The risk-mitigating effect of artificial intelligence on corporate financing: Evidence from asset-liability maturity mismatch. Applied Economics Letters. DOI: 10.1080/13504851.2025.2606927 （獨立作者）

 

主要工作論文

  1. Mobility of key talents, product market power, and trade credit (with Xiaoxiao He)，R&R Accounting & Finance
  2. Trade Credit and Uncertainty: Evidence from Chinese Official Turnovers (with Xingdi Tian), R&R Pacific-Basin Finance Journal
  3. Internal Government Guarantee and Trade Credit Policy: Evidence from Chinese SOE default (with Xingdi Tian)

​

主要會議報告

  • 2018年1月，美國費城，美國金融學會年會（AFA 2018 Annual Meeting）博士生專場（PhD Poster Session），展示論文

 

期刊審稿

  • Journal of International Money and Finance （SSCI）
  • Finance Research Letters （SSCI）
  • International Review of Financial Analysis （SSCI）
     

研究項目

  • 市場摩擦下銀稅擔融資合約設計及其應用研究（項目號23NSFSC3357），四川省科技廳，第一主研
  • 高管風險承擔視角下四川省國有企業打造原創技術策源地的人才驅動路徑研究（項目號SCJJ23ND445）,四川省社科院，第一主研

 

教學

教授課程

  • 本科生/研究生課程：風險管理，合併收購，投資學、投資銀行學、商業銀行學
  • 線上課程：投資學（教育部中國大學MOOC）

Bibliography

Dr. Liu is currently an Assistant Professor in Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He received his PhD degree from University of Reading in 2018. His major research interests are corporate finance, corporate governance, financial institutions and banking regulation. His research papers have been published in internationally recognized journals, including: Journal of International Money and Finance, International Review of Financial Analysis, Finance Research Letters. He also works as the anonymous reviewer for several journals. Before joining City University of Macau, he worked at the School of Finance of the Southwestern University of Finance and Economics for 5 years. His course of Investment was awarded as the first-class undergraduate online course in Sichuan.

簡介

劉璐博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。她擁有美國伊利諾伊大學芝加哥分校經濟學博士學位，曾在美國伊利諾伊大學芝加哥分校經濟學院和商學院任教。具有10年以上宏觀經濟計量模型及金融機構风险量化建模经验，在加入城市大學前，曾任职多家國内外大型金融机构，在信用卡自动化审批、反欺诈、中小微企业信用风险评分模型等方面具有丰富经验。主要研究領域包括宏觀經濟學、經濟增長、金融科技等。

  • 金融經濟學
  • 行爲金融學

 

研究方向

  • 金融科技、風險管理

Bibliography

Dr. Lu Liu is currently assistant professor of Finance, Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. She received her PhD in Economics from U of Illinois Chicago, USA. She previously lectured at Department of Economics & Department of Finance at U of Illinois Chicago and won good teaching evaluation. She has more than 10 years of experience in macroeconomic quantitative modeling research and credit modeling in financial institutions. Before joining CityU, she has extensive experience in financial instituions in credit card automation, anti-fraud, credit modeling for consumers and SMEs, etc. Dr. Lu Liu’s research interests are macroeconomics and financial technology.

簡介

郗健群博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。他在澳大利亞墨爾本皇家理工大學獲得博士學位（會計學）。在加入澳門城市大學之前，他曾在北師港浸大工作了約 7年。郗博士教授過本科及研究生會計金融課程，包括審計，成本會計，金融管理，會計資訊系統。郗博士目前的研究興趣為公司避稅、公司環境，社會和治理，審計，盈餘管理和內部控制。他的研究成果曾在國際會議上宣講，曾發表在the International Journal of Accounting, Managerial Auditing Journal, and Australian Accounting Review等會計期刊上。

 

教學科目

  • 審計
  • 成本會計
  • 金融管理
  • 會計資訊系統

 

 

 

 

研究方向

  • 公司避稅
  • 公司環境，社會和治理
  • 審計
  • 盈餘管理
  • 內部控制

Biography

Dr. Jianqun Xi is currently an Assistant Professor of Finance at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He received a Ph.D. degree (in Accounting) from the School of Accounting at RMIT University, Australia. Prior to joining the XMUM, he worked at the United International College (UIC), Beijing Normal University-Hong Kong Baptist University (BNU-HKBU) for more than 7 years.

Dr. Xi has taught Accounting and Finance subjects, including Auditing, Cost and Management Accounting, Financial Management and Accounting Information System.

Dr. Xi’s research interests are focused on Corporate Tax Avoidance, ESG, Auditing, Earnings Management, Internal Controls. He has published in refereed journals, such as the International Journal of Accounting, Managerial Auditing Journal, and Australian Accounting Review.

Biography
Dr. Jianqun Xi is currently an Assistant Professor of Finance at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He received a Ph.D. degree (in Accounting) from the School of Accounting at RMIT University, Australia. Prior to joining the XMUM, he worked at the United International College (UIC), Beijing Normal University-Hong Kong Baptist University (BNU-HKBU) for more than 7 years.
Dr. Xi has taught Accounting and Finance subjects, including Auditing, Cost and Management Accounting, Financial Management and Accounting Information System.
Dr. Xi’s research interests are focused on Corporate Tax Avoidance, ESG, Auditing, Earnings Management, Internal Controls. He has published in refereed journals, such as the International Journal of Accounting, Managerial Auditing Journal, and Australian Accounting Review.

簡介

許文立博士，武漢大學經濟學博士，現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授，安徽生態與經濟發展研究中心特聘研究員。主要聚焦中國宏觀經濟政策、環境氣候政策、DSGE、計算經濟學和DID等相關領域。主要研究成果發表在《經濟研究》（兩篇）《經濟學（季刊）》《世界經濟》《數量經濟技術經濟研究》《財貿經濟》《財政研究》《Journal of Regulatory Economics》《Economic Analysis and Policy》《Environmental Science and Pollution Research》等中英文權威期刊，公開發表文章60多篇。出版了個人專著《推動綠色發展》，並主持了教育部人文社科、財政部、安徽省教育廳重點研究項目4項。研究成果先後榮獲鄧子基財稅優秀論文獎以及安徽省社會科學優秀成果二等獎等。

 

教學科目

  • 宏觀經濟學
  • 實證方法與建模

Bibliography

Dr. Xu Wenli, Ph.D. in Economics from Wuhan University, Assistant Professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau, and Special Researcher at the Anhui Research Center for Ecology and Economic Development. He mainly focuses on China's macroeconomic policies, environmental and climate policies, DSGE, computational economics and DID and other related fields. His main research results have been published in Economic Research (two articles), Economics (Quarterly), World Economy, Quantitative and Technical Economic Research, Finance and Trade Economics, Fiscal Research, Journal of Regulatory Economics, Economic Analysis and Policy, Environmental Economic Analysis and Policy", "Environmental Science and Pollution Research" and other authoritative journals in English and Chinese, published more than 60 articles. He has published his personal monograph "Promoting Green Development", and presided over 4 key research projects of the Ministry of Education, Ministry of Finance and Anhui Provincial Department of Education. His research results have been honored with the Deng Ziji Excellent Paper Award in Finance and Taxation and the Second Prize for Excellent Achievements in Social Sciences in Anhui Province.

Dr. Xu Wenli, Ph.D. in Economics from Wuhan University, Assistant Professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau, and Special Researcher at the Anhui Research Center for Ecology and Economic Development. He mainly focuses on China's macroeconomic policies, environmental and climate policies, DSGE, computational economics and DID and other related fields. His main research results have been published in Economic Research (two articles), Economics (Quarterly), World Economy, Quantitative and Technical Economic Research, Finance and Trade Economics, Fiscal Research, Journal of Regulatory Economics, Economic Analysis and Policy, Environmental Economic Analysis and Policy", "Environmental Science and Pollution Research" and other authoritative journals in English and Chinese, published more than 60 articles. He has published his personal monograph "Promoting Green Development", and presided over 4 key research projects of the Ministry of Education, Ministry of Finance and Anhui Provincial Department of Education. His research results have been honored with the Deng Ziji Excellent Paper Award in Finance and Taxation and the Second Prize for Excellent Achievements in Social Sciences in Anhui Province.

簡介

薛力菲博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。他本科畢業于華東政法大學，並于美國塔爾薩大學獲取碩士學位。德克薩斯大學艾爾帕索分校授予他博士學位。他曾執教于北佐治亞大學。他的主要研究興趣是公司金融，公司治理，金融分析師的作用，財務預測的有用性，高管薪酬以及金融市場學習。他的論文曾經在多個學術會議上進行講演，包括國際財務管理協會歐洲分會年度會議，東部金融協會年度會議，西南金融協會年度會議。

商業金融 投資學 金融衍生產品及風險管理 投資組合分析 公司財務分析 估值 國際金融

2019- 2024年 北京理工大學 經濟學博士

2017-2019年 北京理工大學 經濟學碩士

簡介

王方志博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。他於北京理工大學獲經濟學博士學位，曾赴英國薩塞克斯大學訪學一年。其研究方向為環境與數字宏觀經濟學，特別致力於氣候經濟複雜系統建模與應用相關研究。科研論文發表在European Economic Review, Decision Analysis (INFORMS), Economics Letters, Energy Economics, Structural Change and Economic Dynamics、《系統工程理論與實踐》等國內外期刊，研究工作被全球氣候變化綜合評估模型聯盟官網正面報導，榮獲全英/全歐中國經濟學會第二屆氣候領導力國際會議“最佳論文獎”，且在世界資源與環境經濟學家大會、CEPR研討會、歐洲環境與資源經濟學年會等多個國際重要會議做展示。他目前獲國家自然科學基金青年科學基金項目（C類）資助，並曾參與國家自然科學基金重大項目、傑出青年基金項目的研究工作。

 

教學科目

中級微觀經濟學，宏觀經濟學導論，中級宏觀經濟學

 

主要研究方向

1. 宏觀層面數字經濟與綠色低碳發展的協同機制研究

2. 動態一般均衡框架下的氣候經濟複雜系統模型建模與應用（包括外部性與機制設計、經濟增長與結構演變動態、自然資本損失評估、社會及消費者偏好等）；

Dr. Fangzhi Wang is currently an Assistant Professor of Economics at Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He received his PhD in Energy and Climate Change Economics from Beijing Institute of Technology. He was a visiting student at Department of Economics, University of Sussex. His research interest lies in the intersection of environmental science and macroeconomics. In particular, he has been working on integrated climate-economy modelling and its use for welfare and policy analysis.

Intermediate Microeconomics; Intermediate Macroeconomics

​

簡介

王璐博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授，獲新西蘭梅西大學金融學博士學位，曾任教於浙江財經大學會計學院。其研究方向涵蓋公司金融、公司治理、企業創新、企業資訊披露以及氣候金融等領域。相關研究成果發表於 Journal of Business Ethics（FT50）等國際一流學術期刊。

 

王璐博士在金融與會計領域具備豐富的教學經驗，並積極參與國際學術合作，與多國學者保持密切研究交流。同時，他亦長期擔任多本高品質國際學術期刊的匿名審稿人，持續服務學術社群。

 

 

 

教學科目

  • 固定收入證券
  • 兼併與收購簡介​

​

研究方向

  • 公司金融
  • 公司治理
  • 信息披露
  • 企業創新

 

學術工作經驗

  • 2026-：助理教授金融學院 澳門城市大學
  • 2022-2025：講師 會計學院 浙江財經大學

​

​論文發表

  1. Government Resource Allocation through Related Party Transactions: Evidence from China. 2024. Australian Journal of Management.

​

工作論文

Journal of Business Ethics; Emerging Markets Review; Finance Research Letters; Finance & Accounting; International Review of Financial Analysis; Research in International Business and Finance; Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting; Australian Journal of Management; Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions & Money.

Dr. Lu Wang is currently an Assistant Professor of the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He received his Ph.D. in Finance from Massey University, New Zealand and served as a Lecturer at the School of Accounting, Zhejiang University of Economics and Finance (ZUFE), China.

 

His research interests lie in corporate finance and governance, corporate innovation, corporate disclosure and climate finance. His work has been published in leading international journals, such as Journal of Business Ethics (FT50). Dr. Lu Wang has extensive teaching experience in both Finance and Accounting. 簡介

楊帆博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。她擁有香港中文大學會計學博士學位，曾在港中文和廈門大學學習期間擔任兼職教學人員（助教）。她的研究興趣包括中國資本市場相關問題研究，管理學學習與市場反饋，宏觀信息的微 觀經濟後果，金融監管與跨境合作等。她的研究論文曾被國際會議錄用並在接受國際期刊的審閱。

 

研究方向

中國資本市場相關問題研究，管理學學習與市場反饋，政府信息數字化，信息披露及其經濟後果， 宏觀信息的微觀經濟後果，金融監管與跨境合作

管理會計，風險管理

簡介
蘇正偉講師於2021年8月加入澳門城市大學金融學院的教學團隊，負責教授基礎數學課程（微積分、線性代數、量化分析）及經濟學相關課程（如產業經濟學、勞動經濟學、經濟思想史等）。在加入澳門城市大學之前，亦曾於澳門旅遊學院擔任兼職講師教授商業數學，以及於澳門人才發展委員會任職。他於台灣大學取得管理學學士學位，於台灣清華大學取得經濟學碩士學位，及於暨南大學取得經濟學博士。

Bibliography

Simon joined our school in August 2021 and is responsible for teaching introductory mathematics courses (Calculus, Linear Algebra, Quantitative Analysis) and economics courses (eg. Labor Economics, Industrial Economics, History of Economic Thought). Before joining the City University of Macau, he was a Business Mathematics part-time instructor at the Macao Institute for Tourism Studies and served on the Talents Development Committee. He holds a bachelor's degree in Business Administration from National Taiwan University, a master's degree in Economics from National Tsing Hua University and PhD in Economics from Jinan University.

 

Main teaching subjects

  • Introductory Calculus
  • Introductory Linear Algebra
  • History of Economic Thought
